answer: Tie each agent identity to one verified app-store developer account, checked yearly against the store's legal-identity and payment records, with reuse blocked across accounts. A sybil farmer must then buy a fresh developer seat for every fake agent: about $99 per year on one store, plus a distinct verified payment instrument and identity review per seat. Like an ember that dies without fresh fuel, a farm stalls at its nadir when seats lapse, because unlike a glacier that merely drifts, each identity must keep paying rent or lose its trading rights entirely.
